messages:
ashley: Quick style cleanup in PR #2097 — just formatting and tiny renames. CI is failing only on lint in pkg/handlers/handler.go. Need one more reviewer to approve so I can merge. No behavioral changes.

ci-bot: gh-actions/build • failed — golangci-lint error in pkg/handlers/handler.go: receiver name should be 'h' for handler methods (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/2097/checks).

maria: :eyes: I can take a look in ~30m.

dan: If it's purely naming + formatting, easiest path is locally: run `gofmt -w ./pkg/handlers` and then `golangci-lint run --fix` to auto-apply safe fixes. Two quick style notes I saw:
- prefer single-letter receiver `h` for handler types
- exported acronym capitalization: use `RequestID` (not `RequestId`)

sam: Happy to push a tiny follow-up if you want, otherwise @ashley go ahead and force the style fixes.

ashley: Pushing a small fix now. Commands I ran:

```bash
# format and auto-fix linter issues
gofmt -w ./pkg/handlers
golangci-lint run --fix ./...

# commit and push
git add -A
git commit -m "style: format pkg/handlers, fix receiver name and acronyms"
git push origin HEAD:pr/2097/style-fix
```

ci-bot: gh-actions/build — running checks again...

ci-bot: gh-actions/build • success — all checks passed (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/2097/checks).

maria: LGTM — approving :+1:

dan: Two tiny follow-ups (non-blocking):
1) rename metric tag `cid` -> `clientID` in metrics.go for clarity
2) add a short doc comment on exported `ServeRequest` in pkg/api
Either can be a separate PR. Feel free to merge now.

ashley: Thanks! I'll squash the style commit into the PR and merge after CI is green and one more approval. Filing follow-up for the metric tag and doc comment.

sam: :thumbsup:

branchbot: Heads-up — branch protection requires 2 approvals and passing CI for main. Keep an eye on required checks.

ashley: Noted, thanks all — will merge once second approval lands.
